requirement_text.REQ-428: Third MOB-4 requirement. Task routes (lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex): GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/claim, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete. The task form is resolved through REQ-424's pinned resolver and rendered by REQ-427's form renderer; never the active version. Process-instance renderer: read-only view of GET /api/v1/instances/:id and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex) -- status, current step, timeline. No cancel/rebind/advance actions (not in MOB-4). All screens use REQ-426's six-state wrapper; claim/complete errors (409 already claimed, 403, 422) map to its states.

task.description: Host memory check just before this run: Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem showed FreePhysicalMemory ~6.0GB free out of ~31.9GB total -- not comfortably above the 4GB floor, so use TEST_PARALLEL_N=2 (not full nproc parallelism) for scripts/test_parallel.sh. Re-check memory yourself before running, and drop to serial mix test if it's tighter than this by the time you run. Run scripts/test_parallel.sh (full backend ExUnit suite, not just new tests -- this run's own diff touches apps/mobile/ only so no backend regression is expected, but Unblock-Everything still requires the full suite). Additionally, since this diff touches apps/mobile/: from apps/mobile/, run flutter analyze && flutter test and record real output alongside the ExUnit results. Write test/reports/report-<date>-WF02-REQ428-20261001.yaml with real output including derived partition count N and its source. If you hit a failure, attribute it structurally (core-directives.md's 'Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching') -- do not call it pre-existing by count-matching alone. If reaped/killed twice at the same settings, stop and report rather than retrying a third time.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/test_parallel.sh run to completion (or a clearly reported memory-constrained stop after 2 attempts) with real aggregated Result:/Failed: counts quoted
flutter analyze && flutter test run from apps/mobile/ with real output quoted
Any failure attributed structurally (diff membership, merge-base reproduction, or measured mechanism), never by count-matching; unattributed failures reported for filing, not fixed here
